digest.component_or_area: MCP server infrastructure / LLM provider integration
propositions: Deployed MCP server container is built with --extra agents --extra mcp but lacks --extra bedrock, so the pydantic-ai bedrock provider package is not installed despite bedrock being configured in rebar.toml
review_plan LLM pass fails with LLMConfigError (llm_unavailable: true) and returns unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict without minting plan-review attestation

MCP compose service and autodeploy mcp_run_new lack AWS region environment variables (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION), causing NoRegionError when bedrock provider attempts to initialize
Local CLI review works because dev environment installs [dev] extra which includes boto3, masking the missing [bedrock] extra in the container image
Fix requires adding --extra bedrock to Dockerfile.mcp uv sync, setting region env vars in docker-compose.yml mcp service and autodeploy mcp_run_new, and coupling test to prevent regression
